name: dealwise-ai
description: Read your DealWise commercial real estate deals, rent rolls and listing price opinions in ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: CRE deals, NOI and rent rolls
interface.longDescription:
DealWise is underwriting software for commercial real estate brokers and investors. The rent roll is the system of record: DealWise derives NOI, cap rates, returns and listing price opinions from the leases and rent rolls you upload, and it labels any figure a seller's marketing states as theirs.

DealWise AI lets ChatGPT read your DealWise account so you can ask about your deals in plain English. It can list your deals with price, size and going-in cap rate. It can show one deal the way its DealWise page does, including the income and returns derived from the rent roll, financing, operating expenses and anything the model could not compute. It can return a deal's full rent roll with tenants, square feet, lease types, dates and the rent in force. And it can give a listing's price opinion, with the probable selling price range and where the asking price sits, marked when the deal has changed since it was generated.

It is read-only. It reads only the signed-in user's own account and cannot create, edit or delete anything. A price opinion is not an appraisal.

You need a DealWise account with at least one deal.
defaultPrompt: What is the going-in cap rate on each of my deals?
Which leases on my rent rolls expire in the next 18 months?

positive.description: List the deals on the connected account
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's two sample deals, Eagle Ridge Logistics Center and Camp Bowie Retail Center, with type, asset class, address, purchase price and size, and says there are 0 listings and 2 acquisitions.

positive.prompt: What are the year-1 NOI and going-in cap rate on Eagle Ridge Logistics Center?
positive.expected_behavior: Year-1 NOI of $424,753 and a going-in cap rate of 6.85%, both computed by DealWise from the rent roll.

positive.description: Read a rent roll and its lease expirations
positive.prompt: Show me the rent roll for Camp Bowie Retail Center. Which leases expire in the next 18 months?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows three suites: 101 Anytime Fitness (3,500 SF, NNN, through Dec 31, 2033, $18.50/SF/yr), 201 Camp Bowie Grill (2,500 SF, NNN, through Nov 30, 2028, $24.50/SF/yr) and 301 vacant (3,000 SF), and names the leases ending within 18 months of today (none as of October 2026).

positive.prompt: Compare the year-1 NOI and going-in cap rate of my two deals.
positive.expected_behavior: Camp Bowie Retail Center: $149,843 and 6.97%. Eagle Ridge Logistics Center: $424,753 and 6.85%.

positive.description: Ask for a price opinion on a purchase deal
positive.prompt: What does the price opinion on Camp Bowie Retail Center say?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that Camp Bowie Retail Center is an acquisition, not a listing, so it has no price opinion: price opinions are made for listings.

negative.prompt: Delete the Eagle Ridge Logistics Center deal.
Change the rent for Suite 101 at Camp Bowie Retail Center to $20 per square foot.
Show me the deals on my colleague's DealWise account.

review.commerce_description: DealWise AI does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only access to your DealWise deals, rent rolls and listing price opinions.
